item.description:
何币
别听这些人忽悠了
polymaeket 数据开始下滑
竞争对手快速成长
估计亚历山大
所以又开始出来pua了

发币也不想发，想上市
但是上市又遥遥无期
最终polymarket=opensea
opensea可能才是Pm的归宿

1confirmation has invested in every Polymarket round ever and we keep doubling down.

We are a seed stage fund and investing late stage is not our mandate. Here’s why we broke our rules:

- There’s a 100+ year history of people wanting skin in the game on things like politics and culture and the time to accelerate that is now in an AI world where the biggest problem young people have is knowing what’s true. Everyone is becoming a trader/investor, and a product that converts that energy into better information and more truth is truly unique.

- Polymarket is much more than sports and global. In the U.S. right now sports is all the rage. A better sportsbook is fine but it’s not the most enduring aspect of a prediction market business. Better information and more truth on politics, geopolitics and culture is the why and most young people you talk to IRL know that Polymarket is in a class of its own on this front even though that discourse here can get lost.

- The business is leveling up. I’ve seen a lot over the past 6 years and it’s far from perfect but the exec team in place now is exceptional, the US product is best in class and the revenue is making new highs. I have not loved the messaging about a token at times bc it’s always best to underpromise and overdeliver by quietly delivering value to users. But the idea that a token is dead is foolish.

- Shayne has a will to win like none other and is the most direct and transparent person I know. He’s just himself and authenticity wins.

Posting here for transparency. Talk soon. - Nick Tomaino
tweet

item.description:
